en: The image shows a colorized street scene featuring historic European architecture, with people gathered on the sidewalk and a horse-drawn carriage. Prominent features include buildings with red roofs, one with a dome. The text on the front is in Croatian and German, indicating the street name and city. The back is filled with handwritten text, a postage stamp, and an address, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
